description: Two hooks, and the difference between them is the design. require_surprises.py BLOCKS an onboarding document whose "What will surprise you" section is empty -- that is definitely wrong and the author can fix it. doc_drift.py only NOTIFIES when an edit lands on a file a document describes -- that is a maybe, and blocking every edit to a documented file would train people to delete the documents. Both self-gate: a repository with no onboarding documents sees nothing.
